text: Now the irregular tags: learn this table and nothing can surprise you. I am your monitor: aren't I, because amn't does not exist. Let's plant a tree: shall we. An order, open the window: will you, which turns the command into a polite request; and don't be late also takes will you. There is a mistake: isn't there, because there is the grammatical subject. Nobody phoned: nobody is already negative, so the tag is positive, did they. Nothing is impossible: is it. And everyone has left: haven't they.
